lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 3 — Peter Heals a Lame Beggar

questions.questionText: Who were going up to the temple at the time of prayer?
What time of day was the time of prayer?
I was lame from birth and was carried to the temple gate every day to beg. Who am I?
What was the name of the temple gate where the lame man sat?
What did the lame man ask Peter and John for?
Who said to the lame man, “Look at us!”?
What was the lame man expecting to get?
Who said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you”?
Peter said, “In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, _____. ”
Which hand did Peter use to help the man up?
What happened instantly to the man’s feet and ankles?
What did the man do after he was healed?
options: He sat back down to beg
He jumped to his feet and began to walk

questions.questionText: Where did the healed man go with Peter and John?
What three things was the man doing in the temple courts?
How did the people feel when they recognized the beggar walking?
Where did the astonished people come running?
Who was the healed man holding on to?
Who asked, “Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?”
Peter said the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob has glorified me, his servant. Who am I?
Who had decided to let Jesus go, but the people disowned Jesus before him?
Who did the people ask to be released instead of the Holy and Righteous One?
Peter said, “You killed the author of _____, but God raised him from the dead.”
Who did Peter say are witnesses that God raised Jesus?
options: Peter and the other believers with him

questions.questionText: How was the lame man made strong?
options: By faith in the name of Jesus

questions.questionText: True or false: Peter said the people and their leaders acted in ignorance.
options: False — he said they knew everything
False — he said angels did it

questions.questionText: What had God foretold through all the prophets about the Messiah?
options: That he would rule Rome first

questions.questionText: Who said, “Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out”?
What did Peter say may come from the Lord after they repent?
Heaven must receive me until God restores everything. Who am I?
Who said, “The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me”?
What did Moses say people must do with that prophet?
options: Listen to everything he tells you

questions.questionText: What happens to anyone who does not listen to that prophet?
options: They will be completely cut off from their people

questions.questionText: Peter said that beginning with me, all the prophets have foretold these days. Who am I?
What did Peter call the people in relation to the prophets?
options: Heirs of the prophets and of the covenant

questions.questionText: To whom did God say, “Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed”?
When God raised up his servant, to whom did he send him first?
options: To the people Peter was speaking to

questions.questionText: How did God send Jesus to bless them?
options: By giving them extra land only
By turning each of them from their wicked ways

questions.questionText: Where did Peter and John first meet the lame man?
options: At the temple gate called Beautiful

questions.questionText: True or false: Peter said he and John healed the man by their own power.
options: False — he said not to stare as if it was their own power
False — John said it was magic

questions.questionText: People used to see me begging every day, then they saw me walking and praising God. Who am I?
Peter said “Look at us!” to whom?
How long had the man been lame?
